policies.title: Maltese ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Special Branch makes tourists from European countries eligible to obtain a visa on arrival; this includes Maltese ordinary-passport holders.
conditions: The live guidance permits tourists from European countries to obtain a single-entry visa on arrival for up to 30 days at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka.

The immigration officer decides issuance after reviewing the required passport, funds, return ticket, purpose and supporting documents. Work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Maltese ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board nationality table lists Malta for a visitor visa obtained on arrival.
conditions: The named Malta row says the visa is obtained on arrival for 40 JOD.
Registration, entry-point, passport-validity, onward-travel, work, residence, special-document, carrier-control and final-admission conditions remain separate.
